dict.string: Paste the Shortcut connection JSON from Cliptext on your Mac.
Use the HTTPS .ts.net connection JSON copied from your Mac. Shared links are still in the local pending folder.
Copy a new Shortcut connection from your Mac. Shared links are still in the local pending folder.
The connection has no valid library identifier. Copy a new connection from your Mac.
Choose a local parent folder in On My iPhone. A Cliptext folder will be created inside it. Choose the SAME parent for Save to Cliptext and Sync Cliptext. Do not select iCloud Drive.
